definitions.gloss: Gospel; one of the four Gospels
definitions.explanation: Any of the four New Testament books — Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John — that recount the life and teachings of Jesus Christ.

examples.japanese: {福音書|ふくいんしょ}を{読|よ}む。
マタイによる{福音書|ふくいんしょ}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like the Gospel of Matthew.

examples.japanese: {牧師|ぼくし}は{毎週|まいしゅう}{福音書|ふくいんしょ}の{一節|いっせつ}について{話|はな}す。
examples.english: The pastor speaks each week about a passage from the Gospels.

notes:
Refers to the four canonical Gospels of the New Testament. {福音|ふくいん} means 'good news,' and {書|しょ} means 'book; writing.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マタイによる{福音書|ふくいんしょ}: the Gospel of Matthew
- {四福音書|よんふくいんしょ}: the four Gospels

RELATED WORDS:
- {福音|ふくいん}: gospel; good news — also used figuratively for very welcome news
- {聖書|せいしょ}: the Bible
- {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}: the New Testament
